patterns: APPSC asks direct recall: Akbar's age at Kalanaur coronation (key 14); other PSCs ask who built Ibadat Khana, who promulgated Din-i-Ilahi, who abolished pilgrimage tax.
Recurring facts: Din-i-Ilahi 1582, jizya abolished 1564 / reimposed by Aurangzeb 1679, first Rajput alliance with Kachhwahas of Amber, Mewar never submitted, Haldighati 1576.
Chronology items are common (Jizya -> Ibadat Khana -> Mahzar -> Din-i-Ilahi; deaths Mubarak -> Faizi -> Abul Fazl -> Daniyal).
Traps: Jagat Guru = Hiravijaya Suri, Ain-i-Dahsala = Todar Mal, Aurangzeb had the most Hindu nobles, Rama-Siya coins = Akbar.
App MCQs drift into Sikh gurus, Shivaji, Iltutmish and Ashoka coronations, and heavy multi-statement items beyond APPSC's one-line style.
